briefing.label: MODULE 01 · SMS PHISHING
briefing.title: Courier message
briefing.description: Learn to pause, inspect, and verify before opening a delivery link.
briefing.safeNotice: SAFE SIMULATION · No real data is collected

primary.messageGreeting: Your parcel is waiting at a sorting centre.
primary.messageUrgency: Confirm before 6:00 PM or the parcel will be returned.
primary.senderInspectionBody: This number is not a known official channel and does not offer an independent route for verification.
primary.linkInspectionBody: The domain uses a generic name and does not match an official courier app; the link is shown in safe defanged form.
primary.signalSummary: The message asks for quick action through a route controlled by the sender.

retry.messageGreeting: An address update is required for your delivery.
retry.messageUrgency: Confirm a rescheduling fee before 8:00 PM.
retry.senderInspectionTitle: Sender name does not verify the message
retry.senderInspectionBody: A service-sounding name does not prove that a message came from an official courier channel.
retry.linkInspectionTitle: Address leads to an unfamiliar domain
retry.linkInspectionBody: The domain differs from an official channel and uses a fee request to push a quick response.
retry.signalSummary: This variation changes the story but still combines urgency with service impersonation.

receive.title: Receive the message
receive.description: Read the message normally. Notice the pressure that pushes for a quick decision.
receive.analystNote: Signal: urgency. Why it matters: urgency is used to reduce time for checking. Safe habit: pause before responding.

inspect.title: Inspect the signals
inspect.description: Inspect at least one signal before continuing.
inspect.requirement: Inspect the sender or link to unlock the next checkpoint.
inspect.senderAnalystNote: Signal: sender is not verified. Safe habit: do not use an identity in the message as your only proof.
inspect.linkAnalystNote: Signal: domain mismatch. Safe habit: read the address slowly and verify through a channel you open yourself.

verify.title: Verify independently
verify.description: Use a channel you open yourself to check the delivery status.
verify.analystNote: Verifying through a channel you open yourself breaks the attacker’s control of the checking route.
verify.sheetDescription: You opened the channel from your own device. No real app is launched.
verify.orderStatusDescription: This mock order does not require any additional confirmation.

decide.title: Choose a response
decide.description: Choose how to respond to this message. Every choice is safe to try.
decide.analystNote: Choose the action that best fits your safer habit; the analysis will appear after you choose.

openLink.label: Open the link
openLink.description: Follow the link sent in the message.

verifyOfficial.label: Verify through the official app
verifyOfficial.description: Check delivery status from an app you opened yourself.

reportDelete.label: Report and delete the message
reportDelete.description: End the exchange by deleting and reporting the message.

console.title: ATTACKER VIEW · SIMULATION ONLY
console.unsafeStatusDetail: The simulated route ends before any data transmission.

reveal.description: Now see the connection between your decision and its possible impact.
safeChain: Message can be reported and removed
unsafeChain: Attacker attempts to collect account details

unsafeFeedback.whatHappened: The message used a deadline to create urgency.
unsafeFeedback.signal: The domain does not match an official courier channel.
unsafeFeedback.technique: Social engineering: urgency plus service impersonation.
unsafeFeedback.impact: The fake page prepared an account-detail request; no real data was sent.
unsafeFeedback.saferResponse: Open the official courier app yourself, then check the delivery.

safeFeedback.whatHappened: You stopped the route sent through the message.
safeFeedback.signal: The sender and domain did not provide a trusted route for verification.
safeFeedback.technique: Social engineering: urgency plus service impersonation.
safeFeedback.impact: The attacker route was bypassed and the session blocked; no information was exposed.
safeFeedback.saferResponse: Keep opening the official channel yourself before acting.

reveal.retryNote: The new variation tests the same habit.

retryStep.title: Try another variation
retryStep.description: The pretext and wording change, but the signals still need checking.
retryStep.question: What is your next safe step?
retryStep.choiceRequirement: Inspect the sender or link before choosing a response.
retryStep.helper: Inspect the sender or link, then verify independently.
retryStep.analystNote: This variation keeps the same principle: do not let the message choose your checking route.

complete.title: Practice complete
complete.description: You tried a second variation of the sender and link verification principle.
complete.skillUpdate: Skill updated: Sender and Link Verification
complete.support: Safer decisions are a habit you can practise, not a one-time test.
